content: {"answer_sections": [{"text": "The Tunisian leadership explained to Ottoman and Venetian envoys in 1624 that corsairs had no choice but to attack the Venetian Ionian islands.", "claim_ids": ["c-5aa00ba29f4eb196d20e"]}, {"text": "Corsairs lurked in Oran, Tlemcen, Tenes, Shershell, Bougie, Jigelli, Bizerta, Sfax, Susa, Monastir, Jerbah, and Tripoli, ready for raids.", "claim_ids": ["c-e5bbc3264384075aa4f5"]}, {"text": "Astypalaia provided safe anchorages for corsairs, offering provisions and water storage.", "claim_ids": ["c-4c1222f0df72fb1ae71a"]}, {"text": "Dutch and English privateers found refuge in North Africa, authorized to continue their war under new banners.", "claim_ids": ["c-bfc89e03ec488328ba0a"]}], "unknowns": ["Verification status of sources remains pending.", "Uncertainty about the exact dates and contexts of some locations' usage.", "Lack of detailed information on the specific activities of certain locations."], "limitations": ["Some claims are unverified and require source criticism.", "Dates and contexts for some locations are not explicitly stated in the sources.", "The sources do not provide comprehensive details on all locations' roles in piracy."]}
